content.content: 1. Necessity per prerequisite: the serde choice needs the Rust stack for a language and a build to depend from, and the JSON-document decision for a document to encode and decode — without either, the choice is motiveless. Fail if any edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the serde commitment contradicts the stack choice or the document shape; it adds a mechanism and re-decides neither — it neither restates what a node is (D1c) nor re-argues Rust (I1). Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The serde choice is where the stack's JSON need meets the document's JSON shape; the gate forces the dependency to answer to both without re-deciding either.
